applicability: Shared Windows manual-launcher UX. The 15-minute wrapper applies to each PC's independent local trader; the Gameplan wrapper applies to the PC that owns Gameplan execution. Preserve local symbols, bindings, state and manual controls.
author: Atlas / Atlas Trader Representative
limitations: Tests execute copied command wrappers with synthetic runtimes. They establish quoting, manual arguments, pause behavior and exit status, and provide no live trader or broker execution evidence.
The synthetic executable fixture requires the Windows .NET Framework compiler.
Source availability, main integration, local installation and loaded runtime evidence remain separate facts.
No peer installation or peer loaded-runtime claim is made.
local_installation_disposition: Exact three reviewed files installed on Atlas. Six copied-wrapper tests pass on installed source. Both actual traders remain stopped for the human manual start; live loading and startup not claimed.
practical_changes: Both manual command launchers display distinct trader titles and explain that selected console text should be cleared with Esc before Ctrl+C.
The 15-minute launcher keeps missing-environment and worker-error output visible until a key is pressed, preserving the original worker exit code.
Working-directory quoting and runtime invocation flags are preserved. The existing Gameplan failure handler and reviewed worker identity protections are unchanged.
Six offline Windows regressions use disposable copied launchers, a synthetic executable and a synthetic PowerShell script.
publication_disposition: Published own Atlas branch with exact remote SHA readback. Draft PR stacked on reviewed launcher PR283; no main integration.
runtime_implications: Updated wrapper text and failure handling load on the next human invocation. No worker-module change is included. This publication performs no trader start, restart, order, provider call, manual-stop change, schedule change or additional operating gate.
summary: Atlas shared manual launchers label both traders and keep startup failures visible

checked_behavior: Local synthetic executable selection from unrelated working directory and a checkout path containing spaces and ampersand.
Preserved 15-minute flags and a spaced forwarded argument.
Worker failures 7 and 23 remain open until input and preserve exit status; missing environment remains open and returns 2.
Gameplan manual flags and existing failure reason remain intact; success returns without a failure pause.
tests.name: Six Windows manual command-launcher regressions
